title: Dualizing complex of a smooth proper morphism
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, that is, a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] scheme, and let $f:X\to S$ be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphism that is smooth of relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] for an integer $d\ge0$. Let $f^!$ denote the right adjoint of the derived pushforward $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on quasi-coherent complexes. Let $\Omega^1_{X/S}$ be the sheaf of relative Kähler differentials, defined as in [def-sc-kahler-differentials] with $C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ replaced by $f$: $\Omega^1_{X/S}:=\Delta^*(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2)$, where $\Delta:X\to X\times_SX$ [def-pc-base-change] is the diagonal (a closed immersion, $f$ being separated) and $\mathcal I$ is the ideal sheaf of the diagonal; on affine opens $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X$ and $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ it is the sheaf associated with the $A$-module $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Write $\Omega^d_{X/S}:=\bigwedge^d\Omega^1_{X/S}$ for the $\mathcal O_X$-module whose restriction to each such $U$ is the sheaf associated with the $d$-th exterior power $\bigwedge^d_A\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. Then there is an isomorphism $f^!\mathcal O_S\cong\Omega^d_{X/S}[d]$ in the derived category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.

proof.text: Since f is proper it is of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism], so X is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]; the projection \operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_S X\to X is the base change of f, hence proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change] and of finite type, so X\times_S X is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] again. Apply the Noetherian derived-direct-image right-adjoint statement [lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint] to f:X\to S and to the diagonal \Delta:X\to X\times_S X. It gives right adjoints a to Rf_* and c to R\Delta_* on quasi-coherent derived categories.

Because f is smooth of relative dimension d and has closed diagonal, the diagonal \Delta is a Koszul-regular immersion of codimension d; in particular \Delta is perfect, and it is proper because X,S are Noetherian.

The morphism f is flat, being smooth [lem-pc-smooth-flat]. The counit/evaluation identity for the diagonal gives \mathcal O_X = c(L\operatorname{pr}_1^*a(\mathcal O_S)) for the flat proper morphism f, by the canonical identity of Tag 0E2Q.

For the perfect proper immersion \Delta, the projection formula identifies c(L\operatorname{pr}_1^*K) with L\Delta^*L\operatorname{pr}_1^*K \mathbin{\otimes^L} c(\mathcal O_{X\times_S X}) for every quasi-coherent complex K, by Tag 0A9U.
For a Koszul-regular immersion of codimension d, the diagonal dualizing object is c(\mathcal O_{X\times_S X}) = \bigwedge^d N_\Delta[-d], by Tag 0BR0.
The conormal sheaf C_\Delta of the diagonal is canonically C_\Delta\cong\Omega^1_{X/S}, by Tag 08S2.

Set K=\mathcal O_S in the tensor formula. Using \operatorname{pr}_1\circ\Delta=\operatorname{id}_X and the Koszul-dual formula gives \mathcal O_X=c(L\operatorname{pr}_1^*a(\mathcal O_S))\cong a(\mathcal O_S)\mathbin{\otimes^L}\bigwedge^dN_\Delta[-d]. By Step 6 and [lem-sc-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free], C_\Delta\cong\Omega^1_{X/S} is locally free of constant rank d, hence so is its dual N_\Delta, and \bigwedge^dN_\Delta is invertible; therefore cancellation yields a(\mathcal O_S)\cong(\bigwedge^dN_\Delta)^{-1}[d]. The normal sheaf is the dual of the conormal sheaf, so (\bigwedge^dN_\Delta)^{-1}\cong\bigwedge^dC_\Delta; by Step 6 this is \bigwedge^d\Omega^1_{X/S}=\Omega^d_{X/S}. Thus f^!\mathcal O_S=a(\mathcal O_S)\cong\Omega^d_{X/S}[d].
